name: Framework TDR for the LHCb Upgrade
notes: Only bibliographic metadata (title, report numbers, CDS record date) was retrieved via the INSPIRE literature API; the PDF itself was not read, so no quote or locator beyond the title is claimed.

summary.plain: The planning document for LHCb's first major upgrade (Upgrade I): a new vertex detector and tracker, and the removal of the old hardware trigger, installed by 2023.
summary.technical: CERN-LHCC-2012-007 / LHCb-TDR-12, dated 26 April 2012 (CDS record date): the Framework Technical Design Report for the LHCb Upgrade (Upgrade I), covering the redesign of the VELO, tracking system and trigger for full-rate (40 MHz) software-only triggering.
